tei:div.tei:p: "$ (63)༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid kyi spyi sdom rtsa tshig bzhugs so/// /

(64)༄༅// na mo ma hā mu drā ya// phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor ston pa la// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang rnam pa gsum// sngon 'gro la'ang thun mong thun mong min// khyad par gyi ni sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum// dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag pa// las 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pa bzhi// dang po'i bsgom bya dal 'byor rin chen 'di// thob dka' 'jig sla da res don yod bya// gnyis pa snod bcud thams cad mi rtag cing*// dgos su 'gro ba'i tshe srog chu bur 'dra// nam 'chi cha med shi tshe ro ru gyur// de la chos kyis phan phyir brtson pas bsgrub// gsum pa shi tshe rang dbang mi 'du bar// las ni bdag gir byed phyir sdig pa spang*// dge ba'i bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya// bzhi pa 'khor ba'i gnas grogs bde 'byor sogs// sdug bsngal gsum gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i phyir// gsod sar khrid pa'i gshed ma'i dga' ston ltar// zhen 'khris bcad nas btsun pas byang chub bsgrub// thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro skyabs sems (65)dang*// rdor sems maṇḍal bla ma'i sgom bzlas bzhi// dang po skyabs yul lha tshom gsal btab la// mdun na bdag sogs ma rgan kun gnas pas// skyabs 'gro byed par dmigs la skyabs 'gro bya// tshad med bzhi bsgom sems bskyed snying nas bya// gnyis pa spyi bor rdor sems sngags bcas bsam// bshags sdom byas pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te// rang gi lus zhugs sdig sgrib kun sbyangs nas// yig brgya brjod pas sgrib byang rtags rnam 'ong*// gsum pa sgrub pa tshom bu lnga po la// dkon mchog lnga bskyed mchod pa'i maṇḍal ni// dngos 'byor yig sprul du ma phul ba las// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rtags rnams rim bzhin 'char// bzhi pa spyi bor bla ma bsgoms byas la// mos gus drag pos gsol btab dbang bzhi blang*// mnyes pa lnga yis bla ma bsten byas na// thugs rje'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags rnams 'byung*// thun bsdu'i tshe na skyabs yul rdor sems dang*// sgrub pa'i maṇḍal lha tshogs bla ma rnams// 'od zhu rang la thim pas (66)de dag gi

/sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med gyur par bsam// khyad par sngon 'gro ma zhen rgyu yi rkyen// bla ma bzhi yis zin pa bdag po'i rkyen// dmigs rkyen bsgom bya'i dmigs pa ma 'khrul ba// de ma thag rkyen re dogs spang blang dang*// dgag sgrub med par gang shar skyong ba'o// dngos gzhi zhi gnas lhag mthong rnam pa gnyis// dang por lus gnad sems gnad lus gnad ni// bsam gtan chos bdun skyon med legs par bca'// sems gnad spyi dang bye brag gnyis las spyi// dus gsum spros bcad gang shar ngang du bzhag /bye brag la ni ma zin zin byed dang*// zin pa brtan byed brtan pa bogs dbyung gsum// dang por dmigs pa dmigs med rlung dang gsum// dang po la yang phyi nang gnyis las phyi// ma dag pa dang dag pa gnyis su 'dus// dang po shel rdel rtsig pa mar me sogs// gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la 'dzin// bying rgod skyon kyang lta stangs nyid kyis sel// nang 'dzin bla ma yi dam gang rung ngo*// de yi ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu ni// rang gi snying gi dkyil du bsgom pa'o// dmigs med 'byung bzhi gcig thim stong par 'dzin// gsum pa rlung ni bum can grangs la 'dzin// zin pa brtan byed snying gar padma ni// dkar nag gnyis las thig le dkar nag gnyis// bying rgod dang bstun ci rigs sgom pa'am// rgyun du spel nas bsgom par bya ba'o// yang na 'jog dang kun 'jog nges 'jog dang*// nye bar 'jog dang dul byed nyer zhir byed// rgyud gcig byed dang mnyam 'jog gnas thabs dgu// brtan pa bogs dbyung yul drug so so dang*// yid yul dge dang mi dge gang skyes pa// de la dgag sgrub med par so sor 'dzin// thun thung grangs mang lhod kyis glod (67)la 'bad// gegs sel bogs 'don ka tho can rnams yod// gnyis pa lhag mthong la ni sems ngo blta// bzhi rtsa bcad dang rig stong gtan la 'bebs// dang po gnas 'gyu gnyis po so so yi// sems kyi ngo bo kha dog gzugs la sogs// gar gnas gar 'gro'i skye 'gag gnas gsum ci// snyam du ngo bo legs par gtan la 'bebs// gnyis pa de nyid kha dog gzugs la sogs// ji ltar gnas shing ji ltar 'phro ba blta// lta mkhan rang yang legs pa rtsad bcad bya// gnas 'gyu gnyis kyang gcig dang tha dad dpyad// yongs tshol sor brtag zhib mor dpyod pa dang*// zhi lhag zung 'brel gsal ba mi rtog pa// btang snyoms rgyun mi chad dang yengs med de// yid byed bcu cig sgo nas bogs 'don bya// gsum pa tha mal shes pa rjen pa 'di// ngos bzung med phyir stong par ngo sprod bya// skabs 'dir dri ba ngo sprod mang du yod// yang na 'gyu snang gnyis kyis ngo sprod bya// 'gyu ba sna tshogs dus gcig spro ba dang*// dga' sdug dug lnga rnam rtog so sor blta// rnam rtog sku drin can du shes pa dang*// dri ba gegs sel bogs 'don 'di na yod// gnyis pa snang thog nyid nas ngo sprod par// snang ba sems yin sems de stong pa dang*// stong pa lhun grub lhun grub rang grol te// bzhi las dang po dmigs rten la sogs par// snang ba thams cad rmi lam ji bzhin du// sems snang ma gtogs logs su med pa dang*// lus sems gcig dang tha dad bral rig na// snang ba sems su ngo sprod de bzhin btab// gnyis med sems de chu nang zla gzugs ltar// stong pa skye 'gag gnas gsum bral bar mthong*// gsum pa stong yang rtsal snang 'gags med 'char// bzhi pa snang stong chen por (68)lhun grub pas// 'khor 'das bsdus pa'i chos la spang blang bral// gdod ma'i byang chub mngon du 'gyur pa'o// de dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa bstan// rjes rtsal sbyong phyogs bogs 'don gegs sel dang*// lam bgrod 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul lo// dang po yul dus ngo bo rang bzhin dang*// shes rab dag la log rtog sel ba lnga// yul ni dge sdig yul la spang blang bral// dus ni dus gsum mnyam nyid bden zhen bral// ngo bo sems las lhag pa'i ye shes med// rang bzhin sems gzhan sangs rgyas logs na med// shes rab thos bsam brtag dpyad kyis mi rtogs// byin rlabs stobs kyis myur du 'char ba'o// mkhas pa gsum la bslab pa gsum yod par// dang por mgo rtsom mkhas par bcos par// ma bcos so ma lhug pa'i ngang nas blta// 'phro gcod mkhas pa ting 'dzin lus gnad bsgyur// skyod mkhas bzang ngan nyams la chags sdang spang*// yang na gshis shor rgyas 'debs gnyen por shor// lam shor bzhi sel dang po brtag dpyad sogs// shes bya'i babs la 'di bzhin gnas snyam nas// blos byas spangs la 'gags med rtsal snang sbyang*// gnyis pa sngags dang yid kyis stong nyid dngos// min bzhin blo yis rgyas btab sgom pa de// tha mal shes pa'i rang ngo bskyangs pas sel// gsum po nyon mongs la sogs stong nyid kyis// gzhil rlom spang gnyen gnyis su 'dzin pa de// spang bya de yi rang zhal bltas pas sel// bzhi pa stong nyid ma gtogs lam med snyam// de la mchog bzung thabs char mi sems pa// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid zhe 'dod bral bas sel// sgom pa'i gol sa bcad cing bogs 'don pa// bde gsal mi rtog pa (69)sogs nyams rnams la// chags na khams gsum gol bas de sngar sa༈༈༈te// chags zhen bral zhing brtson pa bskyed par bya// 'di skabs bogs 'don 'bras bu 'byung ba'o// 'phrang gsum dgrar longs bsal te bogs 'don pa// stong pa dgrar langs thams cad stong pa nyid// yin snyom dge sdig spang blang kun dor ba// stong nyid dang nas lta spyod zung 'brel ba'i// lam la bslabs pas sel zhing snying rje ni// dgrar langs rang gi ting 'dzin dge sbyor rnams// dor nas mi 'grub bzhin du gzhan don byed// rang gzhan dub par byed do sems can la// snying rje'i ngang nas rang gi dge sbyor skyong*// rgyu 'bras dgrar langs rtog pas byed mthong nas// thams cad mkhyen pa byed snyams sgra tshad sogs// sbyangs nas dge sbyong ngo ti dor ba de// stong nyid rgyu 'bras zung 'jug bsgoms pas sel// gsum pa gegs sel nad gdon ting 'dzin gegs// sel la dang po nad kyi gzhi rtsa bcad// yang na gtong len kun gzhir lta sogs bya// gdon ni rang gi sems nyid 'khrul pa las// snang gi don la ma grub gzhi rtsa bcad// yang na gtong len sku bzhir khyer sogs bya// ting 'dzin gegs ni bying rgod gnyis su 'du// de ni dmigs pa spyod lam bla ma dang*// ngo lta la sogs byas pas sel bar 'gyur// bzhi pa lam ni rnal 'byor bzhi yis bgrod// rtse gcig zhi lhag dbyer med don la gnas// spros bral chos rnams stong pa nyid du rtogs// ro gcig 'khor 'das chos rnams ro gcig 'char// sgom med bsgom bya sgom byed kun dang bral// de rnams mi brtan brtan dang rab tu brtan// cung zad phal cher ma lus rtogs pa las// chung 'bring chen po bcu (70)gnyis sogs su gsungs// rtse gcig tshogs sbyor spros bral mthong ba'i lam// ro gcig sgom med 'bring man sgom lam ste// sgom med chen por rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so// bzhi pa 'bras bu de ltar nyams blangs pas// shes rab ral gris sgrib pa kun bcad nas// mngon par sangs rgyas sku gsung mdzad phrin gyis// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'gro don mdzad// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi// rtsa tshig bsdus don dran tho mdor bsdus 'di// slob dpon phyogs glang zhes byas bskul ba las// badzre shwa ra zhes bya'i phyogs bcu pas// rnam thos ri bo'i ngogs su bris pa'o/// /rje dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje/
